Large Rock Mineral Collection Bundle Good and Beautiful Educational Box

Also included is a French-labeled display case with 24 compartments containing various tumbled and raw stones like Microcline, Labradorite, Cornaline, Jaspe, Amazonite, Rhodonite, Calcite, Dolomie, Gabbro, and Apatite in a bamboo-framed glass-covered box. The larger cluster is roughly oval-shaped while the smaller one is more irregular. Natural matrix is present on the underside, with one piece showing greenish mineralization. The combined weight of both specimens is 232.8 grams. These specimens are in raw, unpolished condition. Due to the softer nature and raw edges of apophyllite, flaking or cracks on the edges may be present. No obvious damage is noted. Suitable for collectors, display, or metaphysical use.
